In Felicidad, farmers known as the Farmagia raise monsters under the peaceful rule of the Magus Diluculum. After the Magus passes, a power struggle erupts among forces using monsters to seize control. In the town of Centvelt, Farmagia Ten and his friends band together against the despotic new ruler, Glaza. Ten, his friends, and their home-grown monsters must stay strong to defend their freedom.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Kazuya would have been happy just hiding and cheering her on, but the apartment manager who looks up to him like an older brother is his favorite pure idol, Honami Mizuhara! One day, he sees her masturbating using a photo of Kazuya, and as punishment, Honami forces him into her underwear...? Honami, an idol, licks Kazuya's exposed penis and can't hold back, begging for sex! At this point, he won't stop until she reaches a climax and loses consciousness!

Episode 5 - Tsubomi Hiraku wa Beni no Hana
Tsubaki is an excellent member of the Kendo club, who is able to give instruction to boys as well, and she has feelings for fellow club member Souma, but... One day, Tsubaki appeals to the principal that the club is in danger of closing down, and in exchange for promising to keep the club open, he demands that she let him touch her body as he pleases for a month! In order to keep the club alive, she accepts the principal's invitation... Every day, wherever she goes, the devilish clutches of pleasure attack her, and little by little, her body and mind are melting away...!

Episode 6 - Oshieai
Ayaka lives alone while her husband is away on a business trip. A diligent and sensible young wife, she has been asked by her next door neighbor to be Makoto's tutor. But one day, her sexual desires, which have been building up due to her husband being away on a business trip, can no longer be contained, and she accidentally masturbates, which Makoto sees! As a result, Makoto threatens her and pushes her down... Will Ayaka become more and more drowning in Makoto's young body and overflowing sexual desire...?

59120.description:
Ryuuki Kirishima is a boy who lives with his older sister, Reiko, after the tragic death of their parents in a car accident. One summer day, Ryuuki and his friends gather to watch adult videos for fun. Although Ryuuki doesn't usually enjoy this type of content, he feels inexplicably attracted to videos featuring Kiriru, a new and popular porn actress.

As he watches, Ryuuki feels a strong attraction to Kiriru, and to his surprise, she appears before him in person.

59130.description:
Takuto Ira succumbed to illness at a young age and ended up reincarnating in a world that resembles the fantasy turn-based strategy game Eternal Nations. Not only did he reincarnate into his favorite game, but as the god who commands the evil civilization Mynoghra. With Mynoghra's beautiful hero unit, Sludge Witch Atou by his side, not even legendarily difficult race traits will stand in the way of restarting their civilization! “Lord Takuto…won't you start over with me?” Explore, Expand, Exploit, Exterminate! A tactical fantasy world is waiting for heroes like you! Join Eternal Nations today!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

Wielding his Appraisal skill, Ars continues to strengthen his domain, making a greater name for himself day by day. Meanwhile, the conflict between Couran and Vasmarque Salamakhia over the governorship of Missian Province escalates. With a civil war imminent, Ars must finally make his first sortie as part of Couran's army.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

59135.description:
High school student Saito Houjou is set to inherit his grandfather’s major corporation. First, he must marry Akane Sakuramori, the girl he despises the most, and who hates him just as much. The two are determined to keep their unexpected marriage a secret from their classmates. But as they begin their newlywed life, the distance between them starts to close.

(Source: Crunchyroll, edited)

59136.description:
The "Tasokare Hotel" never sees afternoon, nor does it see night, but rather exists in a state of endless twilight.

This hotel exists in a limbo state, as a place that allows souls who have not yet decided if they are meant to pass on to the afterlife, or remain in the world of the living, to rest their wings. The protagonist, Neko Tsukahara, comes across this "Tasokare Hotel" with no memory of who she is or how she came to be there.

An employee leads the way and shows Neko to her room, explaining, "In these rooms, there should be items that are related to our guests' memories. These items can also serve as clues to help our guests remember who they were before they arrived here." As Neko searches for a way to return to this world and remember who she was, a certain incident confronts her...

(Source: "It’s Anime" YouTube Channel)

Note: Each episode streamed 5 days early on some streaming services. The original TV broadcast started on January 8th, 2025.

59142.description:
Seeking to end a curse thwarting his lineage, Prince Oscar sets out on a quest that leads him to a powerful and beautiful witch, Tinasha, and he demands a unique bargain: marriage. Though unenthused by the proposal, she agrees to stay in his castle for a year while researching the spell cast upon him. But beneath her beauty lies a lifetime of dark secrets that soon come to light.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

59144.description:
Ein has been saddled with the job of "Appraiser," the weakest and least fortunate of all the jobs one can be born with, as the only power it grants is the ability to appraise things. Treated cruelly by all and reduced to a litter collector by his peers, Ein has grown to hate himself and lives his days in spineless self-abasement. But when he meets Yuuri, the spirit of the World Tree, and her protector, Ursula the sage, Ein's fate takes a drastic turn.

With the gift of a Spirit Eye from Yuuri and the help of Ursula in learning how to use it, Ein grows stronger and stronger, until he's ready to take Yuuri on her long-desired journey to meet her World Tree's sisters. He goes on to overcome all sorts of challenges, armed with his natural kindness and his new-found courage.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

59145.description:
Ranma Saotome and Akane Tendou of Tendou Dojo are betrothed to each other by their parents. But Ranma faces a unique problem…

Ever since he fell into the cursed springs of Jusenkyo while training in China, his body has acquired the peculiar trait of transforming into a girl when doused with cold water and reverting to a boy with hot water.

Get ready for the slapstick, action-packed rom com featuring Ranma, Akane, and a vibrant cast of unique characters!

(Source: Ranma 1/2 PR Official Site, edited)

59146.description:
The film's story centers on Anpanman's nemesis Baikinman, but this time, he attempts to become a warrior of love and courage when he is sucked into a picture book. Inside the book is a large forest where fairies live. Baikinman meets the fairy Lulun, who asks him to defeat an elephant that is rampaging in the forest. Although Baikinman is reluctant, he tries his best to defeat the elephant. However, it is too strong for Baikinman, so he tells Lulun to call Anpanman to help protect the picture book world.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: それいけ！アンパンマン　ばいきんまんとえほんのルルン
title.romaji: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Baikinman to Ehon no Lulun

59148.description:
“A villainess without blood or tears”

James Moriarty, the most fearsome criminal, met his demise after a confrontation with a famous detective at a certain waterfall. He found himself possessed by a beautiful young lady from another world, and what he saw there was the insidious abuse by other noble daughters. He has no memory, but his brain is still the same. He wields the power of his lucid mind and the perfect crime equation to the fullest for the sake of only one girl in a world without a great detective. The bullied young lady dies and is reborn as Moriarty, a villainess without blood or tears.

(Source: Comikey)

59150.description: In order to find his cherished partner, Seven returns to Xuanwu Country and faces those forgotten fragments of memory. The dusty truth brings pain and anger, but now he is no longer alone. What is the purpose of having power? This time, Seven has to make a new choice for his life...

59156.description:
The top of the immortals, proud of the world, as long as my ancestor An is there, there is the sky. There are three million sword immortals in the world, and they must bow their heads when they meet me. As a sword immortal, I should suppress all enemies in the world. Who claims to be invincible, who claims to be undefeated?

(Source: iQIYI)

59160.description:
Welcome back to Furin High School, an institution infamous for its population of brawny brutes who solve every conflict with a show of strength. Some of the students even formed a group, Bofurin, which protects the town. Haruka Sakura, a first-year student who moved in from out of town, is only interested in one thing: fighting his way to the top!

(Source: Crunchyroll, edited)
synonyms: ウィンドブレイカー Season 2

59161.description:
Yuu Yuutani is a first-year high school student with sharp eyes, large piercings and flashy two-tone hair. She's become notorious as a bad girl… but she's really not. At heart, Yuu is an incredibly good girl, but her mind is always full of thoughts of the beautiful and popular Atori Mizutori, the school’s Madonna and head of the student disciplinary committee. So, on her mission to attract the attention of Atori, Yuu decided to quit being an honor student and become a "bad delinquent!”

(Source: HIDIVE)

59169.description:
On Meg’s seventeenth birthday, she learns that she only has one year left to live. Her mentor—the Eternal Witch, Faust—explains that she is cursed and the only way to save herself is to grow a seed of life using one thousand tears of joy. Of course, such tears aren’t easy to come by. As Meg begins her quest, she finds herself drawn into the lives of her friends and neighbors in ways she never imagined. By sharing their burdens and using her magic to comfort them, she learns how precious those moments of connection can be even in the face of death.

(Source: Yen Press)

59174.description:
The invitation has arrived. It is time for the New Year’s Reception at the Yotsuba family residence. This year, Miyuki and other candidates will gather there to decide who will be the next leader of their powerful clan. If chosen as the successor, she would never have to see her brother live as a pariah ever again. At the same time, such a position surely entails a political marriage, plunging her mind into complete turmoil. Complicating matters, the current head of their family sows doubt with the shocking claim that Miyuki is not Tatsuya’s sister. When the new year comes, their relationship may be changed forever...

(Source: Yen Press)

59175.description:
After graduating middle school, Tonbo Ooi sets sail from the isolated island of Tokara to Kumamoto in hopes of advancing her golf career. Using his connections, Tonbo's mentor Kazuyoshi Igarashi is able to convince coach Hajime Udou to train her. While Tonbo initially has trouble showing off her abilities with her peculiar playstyle and inexperience with using a variety of golf clubs, she quickly proves her worth at her course debut by making use of her unique skills.

Leaving an impression on Hajime and the people around her, Tonbo is sent to compete in the Kyushu Women's Championship. Met with familiar faces and new rivals, she is determined to dive deeper into the professional world of golf.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

title.native: オーイ! とんぼ 第2期

59176.description:
Fuu and Rui are two sisters who used to be close, but have been a bit distant from each other recently. One day, Fuu encounters a mysterious spaceship and gains magical powers. At that same time, Rui also gains magical powers, and both transform into the adults they dream to be. The sisters' powers come with two conditions: their magic powers can only be used in one year, and no one must know about it. Unaware of each other's secrets, Fuu and Rui become active as idols.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

title.native: 魔法の姉妹ルルットリリィ

59177.description:
Following the massive operation that led to the confinement of recent recruit Kafka Hibino, otherwise known as Kaiju No. 8, the Defense Force has been puzzled by how to deal with him. Kafka is the first kaiju to side with humans, and after careful consideration, he is eventually transferred to the Defense Force's First Division in the hope of adding his power to the strongest division, capable of handling any threat. However, some people are still doubtful about Kafka, and he must prove his worth in the next mission.

Kafka and the First Division are soon dispatched when a massive horde of ant-like kaiju begins wreaking havoc. Thanks to the combined strength of Kafka's friend Kikoru Shinomiya and their captain, Gen Narumi, the mission seems to progress as it should. However, when Kafka fails to transform into his kaiju form, the dreadful Kaiju No. 9 joins the battle with only one goal—to eliminate him and steal his power. Although the situation is looking grim, Kafka must overcome his most difficult trial yet with the others if he wants to keep pursuing his dream: fighting side by side with his childhood friend and Third Division captain, Mina Ashiro.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

59178.description: In the eighth year of Jinghan, the neighboring countries in the north of the Wu Dynasty were at war, and the south was temporarily at peace. When Ning Yi and Su Tan'er came to Lin'an City to do business, they suddenly encountered a dragon turning over. The bandit Thirteenth Army took advantage of the situation to capture Lin'an, causing the couple to be separated. The captured Ning Yi met the Thirteenth Army leaders Liu Xigua, Chen Fan and others one after another. They cherished each other and were both enemies and friends. In the midst of the disputes between the family and the country, the great Confucianists defended the way, heroes rose up, and the world changed...

59179.description:
College graduate Yueran is unexpectedly brought into the fantasy world of Dongji State by a cat and temporarily stays at the shop run by the cat Yaya—Weird Idea Shop.
What kind of completely different strange effects will a human trigger?
synonyms: แมวพิศวงคนอลเวง

59180.description:
Shen La, a special investigator of the "Poll Bureau" of the mysterious incident management agency, was seriously injured in the execution of his mission. When he was about to die, he accepted the inheritance of Wu Rendi, the director of the Sixth Office - a "seed" containing mysterious power. After regaining consciousness, Wu Rendi's senior brother Guangren accepted him as his disciple. In order to find the fragments of the Tianli Diagram, Shen La, after going through the Tianshan Wolf Tomb, energy backlash, foundation conspiracy and other incidents, was finally recognized by Wu Rendi and received the ancient artifact-the Twin Swords of Crime and Punishment given by him. At the same time, the problem of the insider in the polling bureau became more complicated and confusing, and Shen La and her partner Sun Desheng went into battle again.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

59181.description: Suddenly, Fei Xingkong and Si Rui discovered that they were confined to a comic book cage. Their desire was to return to the real world. But in the world of stories that never stops changing, they were forced to escape the total control of the "author"...

59182.description:
The story revolves around the lives of eight current college students. Their different personalities and interests represent a microcosm of life on the modern college campus. They couldn't imagine that four years of college life together will also expose their personality flaws, as they find themselves through their daily interactions.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

59185.description:
Episode 1 - 2: Sex ga Suki de Suki de Daisuki na Classmate no Anoko
Taichi Sano is short of money and, lured by the high hourly wage, applies for a part-time job as a camera assistant. While he is waiting at the location specified by the employer, his classmate Kanna Hiiragi appears. Kanna has a reputation of being the cutest girl in the school, and many boys confessed their feelings for her. Taichi also harbors a faint hope of dating her, so he hopes that this part-time job will be an opportunity to become closer to her. However, when Taichi finds out that the filming will be for an adult video, he tries to refuse, but Kanna accepts, saying that it will help her learn social studies. Taichi feels happy working part-time with Kanna. The part-time job is going well, although he is nervous about Kanna's occasional bold behavior. However, an accident occurs with the cameraman and actor, and Taichi has to suddenly take over. Kanna ends up doing the filming instead.

Episode 3 - 4: Hitori Ecchi:Onanie x2
Nitta is in love with Natsuki Amamori, who sits next to him. However, Natsuki is an honor student and Nitta is not good at studying, so there is no way they can be a match for each other, and she is a girl beyond his reach. What's more, Nitta has a hobby that he can't tell anyone about. He masturbates on Natsuki wherever he goes, even on school grounds. As he was thinking about Natsuki again today, he heard a noise. He peeked in that direction and found Natsuki masturbating. Nitta was transfixed by her. By chance, Natsuki found him. Seeing that she was about to cry after being seen in an embarrassing situation, Nitta confessed that he had been masturbating just a moment ago.

(Source: Getchu, translated)

59186.description:
What happened to Shoutarou, Phillip, and Sokichi Narumi on the night "Kamen Rider W" was born?.....

After the escape from Shadow Fuuto and subsequent battle, Tokime resolves herself seeking out the truth behind the origins of Gaia Memories, Kamen Rider W, and her connection to that shadowy city. Later than night, Shoutarou has a heart to heart with Tokime recounting his painful past and fateful night where everything began, named by Phillip: "Begins Night". A story when dopants started to appear in Fuuto and how a young Shoutarou became private investigator Sokichi's assistant, and tried to follow in his footsteps.

Note: An adaptation of Fuuto P.I. volume #6, which is a extended version of the "Begins Night" chapter from the original Live-Action Kamen Rider W series.

59189.description:
After Sentouin D successfully infiltrated the Ranger Force in the disguise of Hibiki Sakurama, he is closer than ever to defeating the heroic Dragon Keepers. While strategizing his ideal placement in the Force, he discovers that he is assigned to the Green Squadron, whose main duty is to search and eradicate long-lost boss monsters.

Joined by another new member, Angel Usukubo; their senior, Kanon Hisui; and a mysterious informant, Chidori, Sentouin D is first tasked with identifying suspicious activity in an abandoned school frequented by delinquents. During their investigation, they fall into a trap, and the group soon realizes that a boss monster is behind it all. Sentouin D must now find a way to escape alongside the others if he wants to continue pursuing his ultimate goal—achieving his ideal world free from boss monsters and the Dragon Keepers.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

59192.description:
Tanjiro Kamado – a boy who joined an organization dedicated to hunting down demons called the Demon Slayer Corps after his younger sister Nezuko was turned into a demon.

While growing stronger and deepening his friendships and bonds with fellow corps members, Tanjiro has battled many demons with his comrades – Zenitsu Agatsuma and Inosuke Hashibira. Along the way, his journey has led him to fight alongside the Demon Slayer Corps’ highest-ranking swordsmen, the Hashira, including Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku aboard the Mugen Train, Sound Hashira Tengen Uzui within the Entertainment District, as well as Mist Hashira Muichiro Tokito and Love Hashira Mitsuri Kanroji at the Swordsmith Village.

As the Demon Slayer Corps members and Hashira engaged in a group strength training program, the Hashira Training, in preparation for the forthcoming battle against the demons, Muzan Kibutsuji appears at the Ubuyashiki Mansion. With the head of the Demon Corps in danger, Tanjiro and the Hashira rush to the headquarters but are plunged into a deep descent to a mysterious space by the hands of Muzan Kibutsuji.

The destination of where Tanjiro and Demon Slayer Corps have fallen is the demons’ stronghold – the Infinity Castle. And so, the battleground is set as the final battle between the Demon Slayer Corps and the demons ignites.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

At Gloria Private Academy, where stars are born, Beethoven was a fighter, until music chose him. In the prestigious music department, students who match the talent of legendary musicians inherit their gifts and names. Trading his gloves for melodies, he steps into a world where notes hit harder than fists, determined to win the ultimate competition.
